title: Fail closed on unknown Fidelity PolicyConfig keys
objective: Close the source-only configuration-shape gap where an otherwise-valid PolicyConfig may contain misspelled/unknown keys that are silently discarded, including safety-budget override typos, while preserving current Fidelity policy semantics and no-execute validation boundaries.
acceptance: PolicyConfig remains a metatable-free plain record and validation rejects every unknown key before copying/using the config

an otherwise-valid defaultConfig clone with a misspelled maxRegisteredEntities override fails closed in both FidelityManager.new() and evaluatePolicy() rather than silently retaining the default budget
unknown string keys and non-string keys are rejected deterministically without executing caller metamethods
all 13 currently recognized PolicyConfig keys retain their accepted types/ranges and policy semantics; no field rename, schema-version framework, or new config abstraction
retain the project-owned 65,536 registration ceiling and all accepted Fidelity malformed-input, atomicity, determinism, entity-ID, capacity, and state-encapsulation regressions
document the closed PolicyConfig record boundary in Docs/FIDELITY_MANAGER.md
canonical CI, live pr-ownership, and fresh independent exact-head review are required before integration
source-only lane: no Roblox Studio, viewport, physical-contact, performance-device, or two-client evidence claim
notes: Capacity-mined against retained Fidelity capacity PR #419 exact head 1f017628bf49365663dfc2db3a30b81ba477a0a3. validateConfig() currently checks table/metatable and recognized field values but never enumerates keys; copyConfig() then drops extras. The concrete safety case is a cloned default config with typo maxRegsteredEntities = 1: validation accepts the real default maxRegisteredEntities = 4096 and silently ignores the intended override. This lane is intentionally PROPOSED and sequenced after HG-FIDELITY-MANAGER-STATE-ENCAPSULATION to avoid competing edits in FidelityManager while the retained Fidelity lineages remain blocked on trusted-history recovery.
